intentions.title: Guard the doc spine's structural integrity in CI — every routing-table target, INDEX entry, and card Code anchor must resolve to a real file/symbol, doc-tier headers present, canonical-for unique repo-wide
intentions.evidence: scripts/docs-anchors-check.sh checks 6 blocking invariants (routing-table CLAUDE.md targets resolve, docs/INDEX.md entries resolve, card 'Code anchors' grep to real defs, G1 doc-tier header present, canonical-for uniqueness, _attic ARCHIVED banner) plus WARN-only duplication tripwires; bash 3.2 compatible for CI portability.

intentions.title: Enforce hard byte budgets on every doc-spine file so context stays lean — overflow must be resolved by splitting/retiring content, never by raising the cap
intentions.evidence: scripts/check-doc-budgets.sh check_cap() enforces fixed byte caps (CLAUDE.md 10000, api/CLAUDE.md 6500, docs/api-v1.md 14000, etc.) and fails CI with an explicit 'never raise the cap' remedy message.

intentions.title: Keep the paper editor's node-view chrome in lockstep across its Studio-embedded and standalone-bundle mirrors, and generate the paper-surface token layer from one canonical source instead of hand-copying
intentions.evidence: scripts/paper-editor-mirror-check.sh Part 1/2 diffs .bp-canvas-* classes between root.html.heex and paper-editor/src/styles.css (allowlist for documented one-sided selectors); Part 3 delegates to design/paper-editor-mirror.mjs to byte-compare/regenerate the GENERATED --paper-*/--bp-* token block from paper-surface.css, closing drift bugs referenced as 'cycles 57-58'.

intentions.title: De-literalize color across every rendering surface (Go CLI/TUI, Elixir Studio, web) onto the generated design-token system — new inline hex/hsl literals fail CI unless explicitly allowlisted with a lit-allow annotation
intentions.evidence: scripts/go-literal-check.sh (unified-aesthetic W4.10, scans cmd/barkpark, internal/cli, taskboard/theme.go, pdrender/theme.go for #hex outside allowlist), scripts/studio-literal-check.sh (W2.6, scans api/lib/barkpark_web for hsl()/#hex outside GENERATED blocks and per-line lit-allow), scripts/web-literal-check.sh (web-scoped twin) — together form the 'unified aesthetic' token-drift gate across all three UI surfaces; each carries a --selftest tripwire proving the gate actually reds on a planted literal.

intentions.title: Make the task-status vocabulary (statuses, roles, glyphs, tones) single-sourced from design/status-manifest.json, with every consuming surface (paper-surface CSS tones, glyph classes, Go pdrender's inlined roleGlyph/roleLabel/roleMeaning) generated or byte-checked against it
intentions.evidence: scripts/status-manifest-check.sh Parts 1-4: generates/byte-compares --st-* tone CSS from manifest tones, checks .bp-g--<role> glyph-class coverage matches manifest roles, and byte-checks Go's gridblocks.go roleGlyph/roleLabel/roleMeaning maps against the manifest (documented exception for the 'progress' spinner glyph in static terminal render).

intentions.title: Guarantee the Open Graph preview contract is enforced structurally — one write-time preview manifest drives every surface's meta tags, no per-type excerpt forks, no field-projection stripping, and oEmbed is permanently banned
intentions.evidence: scripts/preview-parity-check.sh Part 1 fails if docDescription/paperExcerpt reappear in the web finder detail page (must use metadataFromPreview); Part 2 fails on a `?fields=` projection on the detail fetch (would strip 'preview' off the wire); Part 3 fails if 'oembed' appears anywhere in the source tree, codifying decision D10 as executable law.

intentions.title: Let an instance self-update itself in place via a strictly fast-forward git pull + rebuild pipeline that reports true build outcome back to the admin API, never silently wedging after a failed build
intentions.evidence: scripts/self-update.sh: fetch → --ff-only merge to origin/$BARKPARK_UPSTREAM_BRANCH (refuses on diverged local checkout, exit 2) → suppresses the post-merge hook and explicitly invokes scripts/deploy-rebuild.sh or deploy/instance-deploy.sh so a retry always rebuilds and its exit code flows back to Barkpark.SelfUpdate.Runner; repo-local flock serializes against manual git pull/make rebuild.

intentions.title: Provide a one-shot scripted golden path to stand up a new Barkpark-backed site and ship it live on Vercel (workspace, schema, seed+publish, scoped read token, Vercel project+env+deploy)
intentions.evidence: scripts/bp-vercel-quick-setup.sh runs all 6 steps (create workspace, apply schema, seed+publish content, provision workspace-scoped public-read token, create/link Vercel project and deploy, print live URL) idempotently — described as the scripted precursor to a future `bp vercel quick-setup` CLI subcommand.
